A yet-to-be-identified barber has been hacked to death by suspected cultists, who also severed his manhood during an attack around White House Bus Stop, Okokomaiko, in the Ojo Local Government Area of Lagos State. PUNCH Metro learnt on Tuesday that the incident occurred on Friday. It was gathered that about five suspected assailants allegedly arrived in the area on two motorcycles and attacked the victim in his shop. A police source, who confirmed the incident to PUNCH Metro on Tuesday, said a report was made to the police after the victim’s body was discovered. The source, who craved anonymity as he was not permitted to speak on the matter, said, “A report was made to us about the incident. The victim’s body was found in a shop he had run to during the attack. We are still investigating.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Obi’s 2023 Lagos victory caught us off guard – Fashola Association seeks help for orphans FG targets 24-hour power supply in Lagos, others According to the account, the victim escaped during the first attack and hid behind a water tank, where his assailants could not find him. It stated, “According to residents, the attackers had initially attempted to kill the victim in the morning, but he managed to escape and hide behind a water tank, where they could not find him. “After the attackers left, he returned to his place, not knowing they would come back. At about 5pm, the attackers, who were about five in number, returned on two motorcycles. “On sighting them, the victim fled, but they chased him into the shop of a woman identified as Iya B. It was there that he was shot, axed, and his manhood severed. He was subsequently rushed to the hospital, where he was confirmed dead.” The state police public relations officer, Abimbola Adebisi, said she was not aware of the incident. She, however, promised to find out and revert. She had yet to do so as of the time this report was filed.
